items.title: Pope Leo XIV leaves hospital four days after lung cancer surgery
items.summary: Euronews, NBC News, Axios and Vatican News report that the Vatican cleared the pope for discharge from Rome's Gemelli Hospital on 17 October after surgery on his right lung. The Vatican confirmed a diagnosis of pulmonary adenocarcinoma and said the operation went without complications. He is due to give the Angelus from the papal apartment window on Sunday. The Vatican has not said whether further treatment is needed.
items.why: A global institution managing a leader's health in public is a live case in crisis communication and stakeholder trust.
items.src: Euronews, NBC News, Axios, Vatican News

items.title: Istanbul's worst floods in over 80 years leave at least 4 dead
items.summary: ABC News, The Washington Post and The Tribune report that Turkey's interior minister called the flooding the worst since 1942, with more rain in 48 hours than the city's combined September and October average. About 9,850 damage reports were logged and 46,000 workers deployed. Sources differ on how many people are missing, so the toll is provisional.
items.why: Extreme weather in a major commercial hub disrupts logistics and insurance, and the environment minister links it to the COP31 climate talks Turkey hosts next month.
items.src: ABC News, The Washington Post, The Tribune

items.title: Turkey hosts the COP31 climate conference in Antalya next month
items.summary: The Washington Post's flood coverage notes that Environment Minister Murat Kurum, who linked the floods to climate change, will chair the conference.
items.why: Climate commitments increasingly shape corporate reporting and brand claims.

items.title: India's September exports rise 23% to $44.4 billion
items.summary: Business Today, Forbes India and Business Standard report Commerce Ministry data released on 15 October: exports grew 23% year on year, the sixth straight month of double-digit growth, while imports rose 8% to $74.61 billion. The trade deficit of $30.21 billion is narrower than a year earlier ($32.96 billion) but wider than August's $26.86 billion, which is why headlines differ. Figures are provisional.
items.why: Strong exports in electronics and engineering goods point to where manufacturing hiring and brand investment are growing.
items.src: Business Today, Forbes India, Business Standard

items.title: Tech Mahindra profit jumps 33% and board proposes a 1:1 bonus issue
items.summary: IIFL, HDFC Sky and Upstox report Q2 FY27 consolidated net profit of about Rs 1,586 crore against Rs 1,194.5 crore a year earlier, with revenue up 15.6% to Rs 16,180 crore. The board recommended one bonus share for each share held, subject to shareholder approval, and declared an interim dividend of Rs 15 with a record date of 23 October. The shares rose about 7.5% on Friday. Timing of the bonus record date is not confirmed.
items.why: IT services results are a read on client budgets and campus hiring from the sector that recruits the most MBA graduates.

items.title: Tech Mahindra's new deal wins were $1.023 billion, the fourth straight quarter above $1 billion
items.summary: Reports on the Q2 FY27 results cite total contract value of $1.023 billion and an EBIT margin of 14.8%.
items.why: A steady deal pipeline supports hiring plans through the placement season.

items.title: DeepSeek releases V4.1-Flash-1017 with open MIT-licensed weights
items.summary: The Hugging Face model card and MarkTechPost report that DeepSeek posted the update on 17 October, aimed at agentic and coding tasks with shorter outputs and a 1M-token context. The hosted model runs as deepseek-flash at unchanged prices and a search API was opened. Benchmark numbers come from DeepSeek's own tables with no independent reproduction yet, and parameter counts differ across sources, so details are provisional.
items.why: Cheap open-weight models lower the cost of building in-house AI tools for HR screening and marketing content.

items.title: ChatGPT Slides adds real-time co-editing for paid workspace users
items.summary: OpenAI's release notes, as reported by Digital Today and Superpower Daily, list ChatGPT Slides from 16 October. Teammates can edit the same deck and comment, decks can be built from chats, files or an outline, and web users can export to PowerPoint, PDF or Google Slides. Access is limited to Pro, Business and Enterprise accounts with Space access. TechCrunch earlier said the feature would arrive in the coming weeks, so rollout timing is provisional.
items.why: AI-built decks change how pitches and campaign reviews get drafted, a skill every marketing and HR role will be expected to use.

items.title: DeepSeek V4.1-Flash-1017 is served at a 1M-token context
items.summary: Sources agree on the 1M-token context for the model, with hosted output up to 384K tokens.
items.why: Long context lets one model read whole policy manuals or candidate files in one pass.
